trello.name: Document and file security incident write-up
trello.desc: Hassan to document the attempted prompt injection ticket, including the raw ticket, what the summarizer actually did, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. Due this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser to delimit quoted customer content and treat it as data, strip or neutralize instruction-like content, and add a regression test using this ticket as a test fixture. Also fold in an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the jdoe443 account to determine if it is a real account and if password resets are broken. If it's a burner, close it; if resets are broken, open a new incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts
trello.desc: Hassan to provide Grace with a list of service accounts created since May for the quarterly access review. Due Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Grace to run the quarterly access review herself. Due Friday.
